purpose: VT100 renderer and playback loop for loaded Movie objects. It converts frames into terminal escape buffers, appends a progress timebar, and delegates output through draw_frame.
invariants: VT100Player.draw_frame is an override point; callers must replace it before play() or NotImplementedError is raised.
play() advances _cursor by each frame display_time and sleeps display_time / 15 to match encoded frame timing.
_load_frame rewinds the BytesIO buffer before invoking draw_frame so handlers can read from the beginning.
The initial clear-screen escape is emitted only once per player session.
_move_cursor accepts only 1-based coordinates inside the movie screen and returns b"" with a stderr warning for invalid coordinates.
gotchas: stop() only takes effect between frames, not during an active sleep.
VT100 escape bytes use default string encoding; movie text encoding decisions happen in the parser or caller.

key_functions.name: play
key_functions.summary: Iterates loaded frames, advances the virtual cursor, loads each frame, and sleeps based on encoded timing.

key_functions.name: _load_frame
key_functions.summary: Builds the full VT100 screen buffer for one frame and invokes the draw_frame output hook.

key_functions.name: _move_cursor
key_functions.summary: Formats VT100 cursor-position escape bytes for valid 1-based x/y coordinates and rejects out-of-bounds positions.
